description: The ops label taxonomy. Board Status is canonical; the ops:* label is its cheap discovery mirror (dual-write, same rule as the Delivery board). type:incident + sev:* make MTTR computable (mean signal→resolved on incident-tagged items).

labels.name: ops:signal
labels.description: Ops index: watcher-filed anomaly with evidence bundle

labels.name: ops:triage
labels.description: Ops index: acknowledged, severity being assigned

labels.name: ops:investigating
labels.description: Ops index: Investigator owns it, RCA in progress

labels.name: ops:mitigating
labels.description: Ops index: RCA posted, remediation proposed/executing

labels.name: ops:resolved
labels.description: Ops index: restored, verified by independent health signal

labels.name: ops:postmortem
labels.description: Ops index: sev:1/2 post-mortem in progress (close needs loopback)

labels.name: ops:inbox
labels.description: Support lane: new item awaiting the support seat

labels.name: ops:answering
labels.description: Support lane: support seat drafting from KB + code

labels.name: ops:escalated
labels.description: Support lane: handed to a human with full context

labels.name: type:incident
labels.description: An incident — the tag MTTR is computed over

labels.name: sev:1
labels.description: User-facing outage / data risk — page a human in parallel, always

labels.name: sev:2
labels.description: Degradation with a deadline — post-mortem + loopback mandatory

labels.name: sev:3
labels.description: Anomaly worth a look — may close at resolved

labels.name: runbook:tier-0
labels.description: Runbook granted auto-execution (earned via the promotion rule)

labels.name: runbook:tier-1
labels.description: Runbook requires an external human approval gate

labels.name: runbook:tier-2
labels.description: Runbook is draft-only — a human executes
